name: RC–B10–0156/2025 – After § 18 – Am 13
title: JOINT MOTION FOR A RESOLUTION on continuing the unwavering EU support for Ukraine, after three years of Russia’s war of aggression
part_text: 18b.* *Condemns the death threats made by Wachtang Kipiani, a Ukrainian journalist and historian, against Polish presidential candidate Sławomir Mentzen, in which Kipiani suggested the possibility of repeating the fate of Bronisław Pieracki, the Polish Minister for Internal Affairs who was assassinated in 1934 by the Organisation of Ukrainian Nationalists; calls on the Council and the Member States to impose a ban on Kipiani entering the territory of the EU;
